text:
leo-sales: Heads-up: TitanLedger (payments analytics) wants a 3-week migration POC from CloudPrompt -> Redwood. They need a filled security questionnaire, a POC plan, and a pricing sketch for 12-month commit.
anya-presales: I can coordinate. Need eng and security owners. Is their workload stateful chat + rerank?
leo-sales: Yes, mostly stateful sessions (12k context) + a reranker step and heavy embeddings for similarity.
cheng-eng: Ping me. Immediate notes: long contexts -> need KV cache and longer sequence kernels. Reranker deterministic scoring is critical.
rita-security: Send the SQ. Also confirm EU data residency needs and KMS requirements.
maya-solutions: They require SOC2 and customer-managed KMS in EU. For POC we can do Dedicated in us-east and an EU Private demo if needed later.
cheng-eng: Integration checklist I propose: mapping session header -> Redwood session, tokenization diff harness, stop-sequence mapping, reranker reproducibility test, and a billing projection for 50M input tokens + 10M embed units.
maya-solutions: Quick shim snippet they can run during POC: 
// proxy maps CloudPrompt session_token -> Redwood session
fetch('/api/redwood/chat', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer RED_KEY', 'X-Session': req.headers['session_token'] }, body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-chat-16k', input: req.body.messages, kv_cache: true }) });
cheng-eng: We'll supply a small Python harness to compare token counts and stop behavior across a representative prompt set. Acceptance target: <=5% token delta and rerank Spearman >= 0.95.
rita-security: For SQ: we'll include KMS (AWS KMS + customer keys), HSM option for Private, audit log retention controls, RBAC via SCIM, and a fallback-hosted privacy clause.
leo-sales: Procurement asked about fallback if Dedicated saturates. Short answer?
cheng-eng: Recommend Dedicated commit + autoscale burst to Hosted as fallback. Must call out that fallback is transient, encrypted-in-transit, and no persistent storage on Hosted unless customer opts in. Security will draft contract wording.
maya-solutions: Pricing note: rough baseline for Dedicated commit (2x GPU equivalent) + per-token excess. I'll produce hosted vs dedicated vs private numbers for the one-pager.
infra-bot: staging pool request submitted: job id d-tl-4021.
anya-presales: OK owners: @cheng-eng tech lead, @rita-security sec lead, @maya-solutions pricing/shim, @leo-sales customer lead. I'll assemble the kickoff one-pager and schedule the call for Tue.
leo-sales: Thanks all. I'll share customer contacts after this. :rocket:
